content.text: Kamongo doko nambana pyuo nyingi kendalinya mendeke karamo dokona
kupwa sipyamo karonde daa.
Kamongo doko nambana matarena konambe mendeke ingyaro karapyamo karoŋo
wambu pakaro doko angi api karase?
Akali koo pingi dupwame namba nyuo kuinya palyuo pyamwali lao piraminyi dokopa
nakama lukumapala pao palirami ingilyamo.
Namba ami yanda singi peparaeme nyuo kako pyaraminyipape paka naro ingilyamo.
Dee nambana yanda pimwai dupwame nyuo kuinya palyaraminyipape
Anatu keta mona yukwarala karalu kararo.
Nambame renge mendaki mende Kamongo piso sipu.
Renge mendaki iki nyelana suu pilyu.
Doko namba lete kararono dokopa Kamongona anda dokona iki palyuo karapuli yaka.
Dokona karobaa keyange wakasa ingyuo karamo lao soo nyuo rae maipala
nambame baa kata keyange lasaka pinya lao piso soo kararowale.
Randa eparamo gii dokopa baame namba nee pyuo reto karara.
Baame banya tembole anda dokonape
dee kana londe ketae dokonape lete wai pyao nyuo yalu pyuo reto karara.
Dopa piramopa nambame nambana yanda pimwai karo kako pilyaminyi dupwa nyuo anamasi minyapala yuwa lao mambo pyakaro.
Dokona pii ketaepalyuo rae maiyuo tembole anda dokona bange pyao kiso maipala
Kamongo baa kenane pyao lakandaro ingilyamo.
Kamongo emba lao kyakale laro dokopa soo sakame kumuo karapala
pii yano pyakape.
Kamongo emba karo dokona epo kingi wapambupi lakao lao pisi ipu lapinyi dokopa
isingi lao, Kamongo namba eparowale, lapu.
Nambapa lao yalu pii napipi.
Nambapa imbwa napipi.
Embena kendemande kala pena laa napipi.
O Anatu, nambana pyuo nyingi doko
embame namba nyiso karapi kandapi dokona
namba kyawa yaki nyuo kaeya napipi.
Nambana endangi rakangepame namba yaki nyuo kaeyarambinyipape
Kamongo baame namba sakao yaki nyii nao karara.
Nambana yanda pimwai yuu silyaminyi dokona lao
Kamongo embame namba apa pipili lao suu pilini dokona mana langipala
elyape keta paliru kata dokona lanyuo pupi.
Nambana yanda pimwai dupwame namba kuinya palyuo kyambo pii laokoo keta pyambuo karaminyi dokona
mata joo panda maiya napipi.
Dae karo dakepa Kamongome wambu keta keyange piramo doko kandalanasuu pyao karapusa pilyamo.
Kamongo keta pyamalyuo karape.
Baa kapa ingingi lao suu pyao karape.
Mona nemba napala baa keta pyamalyuo karape.
